how.guaranteeText: If something isn’t right, tell us. Our team follows up, and the technician returns to fix the work within the 7-day warranty – at no extra cost.
how.priceText: The price you see is the price you pay. The only exception is spare parts on a repair visit, which are quoted and approved by you before any work.
how.cancelText: Cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 3 hours before your visit. Online payments are refunded in full to the original method.
how.paymentText: At launch, card payments will run only through licensed Omani payment gateways. Mansoorah never sees or stores your card details. Cash on completion is always available.

about.title: About Mansoorah
about.sub: A student venture with a simple goal: make smart homes in Oman easy, safe and fairly priced.
about.problemText: Modern housing and smart devices are spreading fast across Oman, but stores rarely install what they sell. Homeowners end up relying on unverified freelancers, with unclear prices and no follow-up. There was no central, trusted after-sales service for smart homes.
about.ideaText: Mansoorah is a lean web platform that connects homeowners with verified, background-checked Omani technicians – with fixed prices, transparent ratings and fast home visits. No app needed.
about.missionText: To make every smart-home installation in Oman safe, simple and fairly priced, by trusted local hands.
about.visionText: To be Oman’s go-to platform for smart-living services, and a steady source of skilled work for Omani technicians.
about.teamSub: Six UTAS students building Mansoorah as part of UNEP2109 – Entrepreneurship, Creativity and Innovation.
about.utasText: Mansoorah started as a course project at the University of Technology and Applied Sciences. This website is a working prototype; the business is not yet registered.
